profile.headline: Associate Software Developer
profile.summary: A poly-skilled software developer, I am experienced in full stack development, becoming competent with Angular, Python, C#, Entity Framework Core, and various other languages and tools through my current occupation, career, and my personal projects.

positions.title: Associate Software Developer
positions.description: Contract to develop Angular and C# web application for applying to work with/at casinos for the Michigan Gaming Control Board. Added new endpoints to C# backend, added improvements to Entity Framework Core for controllers, services, repositories. Made migrations with EF Core. Updated SQL scripts and added new view scripts. Added new features to Angular 17 frontend based on requirements listed on Jira tickets and fixed bugs. Reviewed coworkers code, peer reviewed new features with testers and Business Analysts, demoed new functionality on the app to clients at MGCB.
positions.insights: Skills: C# · Angular · Entity Framework · Full-Stack Development · SQL

positions.title: Information Management Programming Specialist
positions.description:
- Temporary position developing software for county departments including ME office, LWRD, etc.
- Built proof of concept case management system for Medical Examiner office using ASP.NET MVC, SQL, Blazor, and other tools
- Helped design front-end, implement hotfixes for department sites, and tested database updates
positions.insights: Skills: C# · Blazor · ASP.NET MVC · SQL

positions.title: Software Developer
positions.description:
- Developed software for state and local foster care and juvenile delinquency justice systems
- Developed web applications using Vue.js and FormKit for frontend, NestJS for backend
- Deployed code to production using Azure DevOps and Argo CD

positions.title: Software Engineer II
positions.description:
- Increased order efficiency by building internal website for tracking cable orders using Flask and Linux
- Managed server automation and updated payloads using Jenkins, internal DevOps tools, and Salesforce
- Presented website changes and new order tracking features to company executives 
- Wrote unit tests and reviewed coworkers code, approving merge requests (Python, Flask)

positions.title: Software Developer
positions.description:
- Developed Angular mobile web app to control horticultural lighting in research facilities
- Designed client-side architecture for authorization, HTTP requests/responses, UI components
- Used Bootstrap 4 alongside other Angular libraries to design the mobile UI layout
- Wrote unit tests in Jasmine and Karma to ensure code quality of UI and routing logic
- Code reviewed coworkers' code to ensure coworkers' code is bug free, efficient, and readable

positions.title: Student
positions.description: Attended college; one class remaining until graduation

positions.title: Software Developer (College Program)
positions.description:
- Migrated a legacy paint job management and automation application to Microsoft Azure
- Performed bug fixes for UI (Angular 8 and SCSS) and C# API calls
- Implemented user stories in web app frontend and C# API
- Wrote frontend and backend unit tests

positions.title: IT Application Development Intern
positions.description:
•	Worked in the DGS/Internet Servicing Policy business solutions area
•	Developed frontend of user-facing insurance policy management web application using Angular
•	Upgraded Angular 5 project to Angular 7 by refactoring and removing deprecated methods and libraries
•	Used Splunk functionalities to query and subsequently fix logged application and user error data
•	Developed automated test suite in Ruby and used Gherkin/Cucumber to write test scenarios

positions.title: IT Application Development Intern
positions.description:
•	Worked in the DGS Property and Casualty business solutions area
•	Developed a billing timeline app for members to view and track policy billing information and payments
•	Implemented UI design in view layer and data parsing/formatting in adapter layer of billing timeline app
•	Captured stub data using Postman to allow for testing while third-party servers were down
•	Rewrote automated test suite from Java to Ruby
•	Contributed to the development of test suite scenarios for member-facing claims submission application

positions.title: Technician
positions.description:
•	Contract position for the Scavenger Project in support of Apple iOS Maps application.  
•	Used Apple Fulcrum application to capture images based on predetermined access points in Dayton,          Columbus, and Cincinnati.

projects.title: Find-it/Poly
projects.description:
Nationwide Hackathon 2019
•	Built Angular app to help employees find other employees with desired skill sets
•	Implemented search filtering to narrow down results of poly-skilled associates
•	Mocked up database of users with skillsets

projects.title: Intern Orientation Scheduler
projects.description:
Nationwide Hackathon 2018
•	Created a mock scheduling and communicating web application for Nationwide intern orientation
•	Integrated Google Maps to help interns navigate Nationwide’s campus
